name: Handheld Quaker
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
description: This small toy-like device has a hidden mechanism meant to be activated by the user, but the centuries have eroded its magical-mechanical components to the point that they activate at the slightest touch.
disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to deactivate the mechanism; DC 16 Crafting check (trained) to identify and repair the problem components; two successes are required to disable the hazard.
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without a creature being within 5' of the handheld quaker.
routine:
At its initiative, to determine what the quaker does, roll 1d4 and consult the following table:

1: No action

2: A small quake: the terrain in a 10 foot emanation centered on the quaker shakes briefly. A creature in an affected square is knocked Prone (DC 18 Reflex save).

3: A medium quake: the terrain within the vault shakes constantly, transforming it into difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is knocked prone and takes 1d10 bludgeoning damage from the fall (DC 18 basic Reflex save).

4: A great quake: the terrain within the vault moves in waves, transforming it into greater difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is violently slammed to the ground, knocked prone, and takes 1d10+4 bludgeoning damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Quake!
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves into a space with the handheld quaker or interacts with it

Effect The handheld quaker vibrates visibly and rolls initiative.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shaking Earth
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature within difficult terrain created by the quaker takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves and actions with the Manipulate trait, including Disable Device.
